description: One-call safety and setup audit for a domain: verdict (score + grade + summary) and a ranked list of issues, plus DNS, email security (SPF, DKIM on common selectors, DMARC, MTA-STS), SSL certificate (trust, issuer, expiry, days left, SANs, TLS version), domain age and registrar (RDAP), and HTTP redirect chain with security headers. Flags scam signals like newly registered domains and untrusted certificates. Price: $0.01 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).
